items.article_summary_en: The Federal Reserve, the central bank of the United States, provides the nation with a safe, flexible, and stable monetary and financial system. The survey was conducted in collaboration with the Federal Reserve Bank of New York between September 18, 2026, and September 28, 2026, and includes responses from banks that held around three-fourths of total banking system reserve balances at the time of the survey. For media inquiries, please e-mail [email protected] or call (202) 452-2955. 20th Street and Constitution Avenue N.W., Washington, DC 20551
items.article_context_en: Secure .gov websites use HTTPSA lock (LockLocked padlock icon) or https:// means you've safely connected to the .gov website. Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites. The Federal Reserve, the central bank of the United States, provides the nation with a safe, flexible, and stable monetary and financial system. The Senior Financial Officer Survey is used by the Board to obtain information about banks' reserve balance management strategies and practices, their expectations around the size of their balance sheets and deposit balances their activity in money markets, and their views on other matters, such as operations on weekends and holidays. The survey was conducted in collaboration with the Federal Reserve Bank of New York between September 18, 2026, and September 28, 2026, and includes responses from banks that held around three-fourths of total banking system reserve balances at the time of the survey. For media inquiries, please e-mail [email protected] or call (202) 452-2955. 20th Street and Constitution Avenue N.W., Washington, DC 20551
